Define Research Domains
Establish nine diverse STEM & professional fields
Finance, law, medicine, physics, etc.

Select 101 Prompts
Curate 101 challenging single-turn prompts
Open-ended exploratory deep research

Expert 1 Drafting
STEM expert drafts prompt & criteria
Zero LLM seeding, 20-43 criteria per task

Expert 2 Iterative Review
Independent peer checks scope & ambiguities
Challenge factuality and verifiability

Expert 3 Final Adjudication
Senior auditor resolves disagreements
2,800+ total expert human hours

Classify Evaluation Axes
Partition rubrics across six dimensions
Coverage, rigor, methodology, depth, etc.

Assign Signed Weights
Mandatory vs optional criterion weights
Define positive bonuses and fatal penalties

Frozen Criterion Database
2,593 verified prompt-specific criteria
Fine-grained rubric specifications

Execute Deep Research
Agent conducts exhaustive web & document search
Synthesizes comprehensive research dossier

Criterion-Level Inspection
Evaluate generated report against each criterion
Extract evidentiary text spans

Ternary Protocol Grading
Assign 0 (fail), 0.5 (partial), or 1 (pass)
Human and model judge alignment

Weighted Rubric Aggregation
Multiply ternary scores by signed weights
Compute domain & axis compliance ratios

Multi-Slice Evaluation Report
Report scores by domain and criterion axis
Task-complexity sliced performance curves
